title: [Mouse Without Borders] Use policy IP mapping rules without user rules

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The policy-only mapping path is now enabled even when the user mapping list is empty. The helper treats policy/user rules symmetrically, and its null/empty handling agrees with the existing mapping-line composition. The nullable-annotation comments do not establish a runtime defect; coalescing the null test input would instead stop testing that input.

**Validation scope:** The exact helper body passed a six-row focused compilation/truth-table harness, and its connection-path caller was checked. This is not a product App build, a repository test-suite run or a real policy/network connection test. No additional code change is requested by this qualified assessment; it is not an unconditional approval.
